description: Convert a CSS resolution among dppx, dpi and dpcm. The alias x means dppx. One dppx is 96 dpi, and one inch is 2.54 cm, so one dpcm is 127/4800 dppx. Exact rationals. Returns JSON with: value, unit, dppx, dppxFraction, dpi, dpiFraction, dpcm, dpcmFraction. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/css-resolution
